bugDescription: Project Detail Page routing is not working

timeline.label: Analyzing repository
timeline.detail: Navigating to a project's detail page (e.g., `/projects/awesome‑project`) does not render the page.

timeline.label: Applying fix
timeline.detail: Patch could not be applied cleanly

report.summary: Navigating to a project's detail page (e.g., `/projects/awesome‑project`) does not render the page.

reproduction.details: The page component is marked as a client component (`'use client'`) yet tries to read the dynamic route parameter `params` from its props. In Next JS the `params` prop is only supplied to **server** components. A client component receives no `params`, so `projectData[params.slug]` is always undefined and the page always shows “Project not found”, making the routing appear broken.

rootCause.summary: The page component is marked as a client component (`'use client'`) yet tries to read the dynamic route parameter `params` from its props. In Next JS the `params` prop is only supplied to **server** components. A client component receives no `params`, so `projectData[params.slug]` is always undefined and the page always shows “Project not found”, making the routing appear broken.

evidence.description: The file is declared as a client component, which prevents Next.js from passing route params via props.
The component expects `params.slug` from props, which will be undefined in a client component.
evidence.content: export default function ProjectDetail({ params }: { params: { slug: string } }) {

evidence.description: When `params` is undefined the lookup fails and the fallback UI is rendered.
evidence.content:
const project = projectData[params.slug]; if (!project) return
Project not found
;

fix.diff:
*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: app/projects/[slug]/page.tsx
@@
-'use client';
+// This page should be a **server component** so that Next.js can pass the dynamic
+// route parameters (`params`) directly as props. Removing the `'use client'`
+// directive restores the expected behaviour.
*** End Patch
